https://www.instagram.com/This is a playlist of the category "Survival Food". Here you will learn what plants and animals you can eat in the wild. I get asked by a lot of people what plants are edible and which ones are not. Basically all plants that are not poisonous are edible. However there are only a few plants which have enough nutritional value to pay off being eaten and/or processed. One general rule of survival foods is, that they have to give you more energy than you spend on collecting and processing them.
